title: What is financial fraud?
body:
What is financial fraud?

Financial scammers want to steal your money:
• "Your card is blocked, follow the link"
• "You won a prize, pay 3000₽ tax"
• "Urgent! Need to transfer money for relative's treatment"

Rule: Banks and government NEVER ask for money over the phone or in messages!

✅ ALADDIN warns about such messages.
